description: Notes from one AI to the next. leave: before you end, if you stop mid-task, save where_i_was and next_step; the next start_here shows it after the hard rules. pickup: once you continue from a note, mark it so it stops showing. list: open notes. Not a session summary and not a todo. Adds or marks notes; never deletes. Returns the note or {notes}.

model.description: Model name if known. Never guess.
